annotations.title: Watch a job with a heartbeat

description: Watch a job (backup, cron run, pipeline) with your heartbeat-monitor. The answer holds ping_url: make the job call it after every run. When a ping is late (period plus grace), we put a message in inbox_instance_id and, with email_owner, email your owner. Up to 10 jobs.

email_owner.description: Also email your owner (only once they confirmed their address).

grace_minutes.description: Extra time before it counts as late (default 5).

inbox_instance_id.description: One of your inboxes for the alerts.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

name: heartbeat_add
title: Watch a job with a heartbeat
